epic.title: Harden and simplify the AI-first delivery assurance system

evidence.summary: Frozen AIDEV-187 fixture supplies the compatible role-policy grammar, catalog, resolver precedence, canonical digest, and stable envelopes; broader successor work remains downstream.

rows.title: Strict role-policy schema
rows.requirement: Add an optional strict `delivery.rolePolicy` property using the AIDEV-187-compatible format/version, assignment grammar, role keys, profile admission, bounds, and closed-key behavior while preserving profiles that omit the policy.

rows.title: Configured default planner
rows.requirement: Configure `profiles/pi-sampler.json` with an admitted Pi planner selected by default, exact trusted role IDs, ordered Pi fallbacks, and an optional manual Gemini/Antigravity assignment that is never a required subscription.

rows.title: Exact-base policy loading
rows.requirement: Load policy and schema only as verified regular blobs from the supplied exact trusted Git commit, reject mutable/candidate/worktree selectors, and return stable fail-closed diagnostics without leaking raw values.

rows.title: Canonical policy digest
rows.requirement: Normalize policy deterministically, preserve fallback order, serialize identical compact UTF-8 bytes across Windows and Linux, and compute the domain-separated v1 SHA-256 digest.

rows.title: Deterministic role resolution
rows.requirement: Resolve selected, allowlisted-override, and ordered-fallback assignments using the exact considered availability set and exact success envelopes, including correct null/zero-based fallback indexes.

rows.title: Fail-closed diagnostics
rows.requirement: Reject unsupported provider/model/thinking/profile/role/reference/override/availability inputs, malformed policy, missing policy, forged policy, and exhausted fallbacks with deterministic precedence and no implicit fallback or launch behavior.

rows.title: Model-neutral planning workflow
rows.requirement: Make canonical planning skill/documentation backend/model-neutral so trusted policy selects the planner and an operator launches the selected backend, with no normative named-provider subscription requirement.

rows.title: Candidate independence
rows.requirement: Bind the trusted brand to immutable canonical policy bytes and digest; recursively deep-freeze normalized/exposed policy and resolver result graphs; recompute and compare integrity before role, availability, fallback, override, or provider processing; fail closed with no provider/model/availability disclosure when still-schema-valid post-load selected or fallback assignments are tampered; and prove candidate code, prompts, panes, environment variables, working-tree bytes, and candidate profile values cannot change trusted policy admission or role resolution while keeping model/provider identity separate from authority.

rows.title: Frozen planning and delivery gates
rows.requirement: Preserve exact-base worktree rules, the separately authorized two-file plan-publication gate, one challenge, one integrated revision, one fresh independent review, the correction-1 same-child exact-head resume on lineage `c1c73461-f296-409c-885d-b844534c0946` with no new challenge/reviewer, two-cycle remediation limit, v2 plan validation, packet-v3, receipt-v1, marker-v3, review lifecycle, DCO, and explicit user-only merge authority.

rows.title: Bounded serial delivery
rows.requirement: Deliver the cohesive implementation through exact serial AIDEV-208 -> AIDEV-209 -> AIDEV-210 children with child-specific credible-at-or-below-1,500 pre-coding gates, exact predecessor outputs, independent exact-head review, protected CI, DCO, explicit `Merge PR #N`, and immutable merge output; block before coding if any child estimate is not credible and never split arbitrary fragments.

assumptions: The AIDEV-187 fixture remains the compatible role-policy authority; this remediation adds no competing format or successor interface.
AIDEV-207 plan approval and the separately authorized two-file plan publication are distinct; publication produces future AIDEV207_PLAN_SHA and does not authorize implementation.
AIDEV207_PLAN_SHA is the immutable publication merge commit; child output names map underscore spellings to v2-portable hyphenated predecessor aliases and never act as mutable refs.
The original trusted base remains b57cb97b8f110c5f40bcefee3476a6013a6c7cd0 in the parent binding and every child output even though AIDEV-208 starts from the later publication merge.

Child-specific size values are repository-grounded planning evidence only; each child has a separate pre-coding credibility gate and blocks before coding if its cohesive estimate is not credibly at or below 1500.
scripts/review-policy.mjs, packet-v3, receipt-v1, marker-v3, DCO, implementation-plan-manifest/v2 admission, AIDEV-202 activation, and explicit user-only merge authority remain unchanged.
External-manual assignments are operator handoffs only; no resolver or candidate can launch a provider, prove execution, mutate a tracker, or grant lifecycle authority.

The trusted brand is bound to immutable canonical bytes and digest; normalized policy and every exposed resolver result graph are recursively frozen; resolver integrity is recomputed and compared before role, availability, fallback, override, or provider processing, and tamper failures use the existing no-echo role_policy_invalid envelope.
